subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team, I am excited to announce that we will be having a team building event next month on the 15th. The event will include various activities such as a scavenger hunt, team challenges, and a BBQ lunch. This will be a great opportunity for us to bond and have some fun outside of work. Please mark your calendars and stay tuned for more details. Looking forward to seeing everyone there! Best regards, [Your Name]
